text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent, and since you are a newborn, I will be asking your parents about your health. To begin, how many days old is your baby, and have you noticed any fever or unusual crying patterns?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Severe congenital pneumonia.

Thank you for that history. Given the lack of prenatal care and immunizations, I need to know if the baby has any difficulty breathing, such as rapid breathing, grunting, or flaring nostrils. Also, has there been any coughing, or has the baby been feeding well?
